summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.getUTCFullYear in its own file. It gets the time value through `date::this_time_value(agent, this)?`, which should cover the RequireInternalSlot step. It returns NaN when the time value is NaN, and otherwise returns `Value::Number(date::year_from_time(tv))`. The step comments are kept above the matching code. The `args`/`new_target` parameters are renamed to `_args`/`_new_target` because they are now unused, which is the only non-logic change. The gate reports a build with no errors, clippy clean, and 8 new test262 passes with no regressions. No special-casing, hardcoded values, or swallowed errors appear in the diff. I could not read `crate::support::date`, so I have not checked that `this_time_value` performs the RequireInternalSlot check or that `year_from_time` computes YearFromTime correctly. Those helpers are the only thing a later reviewer should verify.
notes_for_next_attempt: The diff looks correct as submitted. Before merging, confirm that `support::date::this_time_value` throws a TypeError when `this` is not an object or lacks [[DateValue]], as RequireInternalSlot does, and that `support::date::year_from_time` implements YearFromTime (the largest integer y with TimeFromYear(y) <= tv). Neither helper is visible in this diff.
